Description: Accidental inclusion of confidential client financials or proprietary strategic roadmaps in third-party LLM prompt context.
Mitigation Strategy: Enforce Zero-Data-Retention enterprise API endpoints; implement automated client name and revenue regex tokenization before prompt construction.

Description: LLM generates plausible but inaccurate commentary regarding ad performance attribution or false explanations of campaign metrics.
Mitigation Strategy: Mandatory human consultant review before sending reports; ground LLM exclusively on deterministic API metric deltas with strict temperature=0.1 settings.

Category: Ad Network API Rate Limits & Schema Drift
Description: Meta or Google Ads updates reporting API schemas or throttles automated pipeline calls during month-end peaks.
Mitigation Strategy: Implement exponential backoff retry queues, local schema validation caching, and automated alert fallback to manual export.

Description: Consultants bypass automated drafting tools due to distrust or lack of clear training, continuing manual copy-pasting.
Mitigation Strategy: Involve senior consultants directly in prompt co-design; implement 1-click Slack review UI to minimize cognitive friction; measure weekly time saved.

Description: Contractor invoice with non-standard formatting results in misread line item amounts or wrong task code mapping in QuickBooks.
Mitigation Strategy: Mandatory finance lead approval step before QuickBooks bills are scheduled; flag all line items with confidence score below 95%.

Description: Autonomous agent making unauthorized changes to live client ad campaigns or budgets.
Mitigation Strategy: Hard-stop policy: Absolute prohibition of unsupervised write API access to client ad spend. All automations require human signoff.
